episodes.title: Into the Ring
episodes.summary: Matt Murdock, a Marvel Comics hero who's a lawyer by day but fights the bad guys at night to avenge the murder of his father, a boxer. But what sets Matt apart from most superheroes isn't his back story it's his handicap. Matt is blind, the result of a childhood accident that may have removed his ability to see but gifted him with heightened senses of touch, taste, hearing and smell.

episodes.title: Cut Man
episodes.summary: As Claire nurses Matt back to health, she discovers that her patient is much more than an ordinary man. Meanwhile, Matt recalls the events that led to him becoming Daredevil.

episodes.title: Rabbit in a Snowstorm
episodes.summary: Murdock and Foggy take on a mysterious wealthy client, but Murdock is convinced that there's more to the case than just the facts.

episodes.title: In the Blood
episodes.summary: Daredevil goes after the Russians who have abducted Claire. Meanwhile, Wilson goes on a dinner date with Vanessa.

episodes.title: World on Fire
episodes.summary: Fisk moves forward with plans that threaten to rip Hell's Kitchen apart. Murdock and Foggy take on a case helping tenants victimized by a slumlord.

episodes.title: Condemned
episodes.summary: Daredevil finds himself trapped in the fallout of Fisk's plan to take control of Hell's Kitchen. Ben Urich digs closer to the truth.

episodes.title: Stick
episodes.summary: An important figure from Murdock's past reemerges seeking his help to battle a new enemy threatening Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Shadows in the Glass
episodes.summary: While Murdock, Foggy and Karen's mission becomes clearer, Fisk's world spins further out of control in his battle for Hell's Kitchen.

episodes.title: Speak of the Devil
episodes.summary: When Fisk gains the upper hand, the goal to destroy him becomes even more difficult, while Daredevil faces his own demons.

episodes.title: Nelson v. Murdock
episodes.summary: Murdock and Foggy's relationship is put to the ultimate test while a new enemy against Fisk emerges.

episodes.title: The Path of the Righteous
episodes.summary: Fisk and Murdock wrestle with the consequences of their chosen paths, while Ben and Karen get closer to Fisk's true past.

episodes.title: The Ones We Leave Behind
episodes.summary: Fisk seeks revenge while Karen is haunted by recent events. Daredevil makes a startling discovery about Fisk's financing.

episodes.title: Daredevil
episodes.summary: In the season finale, a boxed-in Fisk and a desperate Murdock, Foggy and Karen are forced to play their end games.

episodes.title: Bang
episodes.summary: The New York City underworld is up for grabs after Wilson goes to jail. A new party arrives in town to kill all of the mobsters, and Daredevil goes after them.

episodes.title: Dogs to a Gunfight
episodes.summary: Matt recovers from the Punisher's head shot, while Foggy and Karen arrange a deal with DA Samantha Reyes to get their client Grotto into WITSEC. However, Reyes needs Grotto to do one thing before she agrees.

episodes.title: New York's Finest
episodes.summary: Punisher has a discussion with a captive Daredevil about what they do and why. Meanwhile, Reyes threatens to shut down Nelson & Murdoch, and Karen sets out to get something on the DA. At the hospital ER, Foggy turns to Claire for help locating a missing Matt.

episodes.title: Penny and Dime
episodes.summary: An Irish mobster seeking revenge for Punisher killing his son--and the $1.2 million that Punisher stole--arrives in Hell's Kitchen. Meanwhile, Karen gets a lead on Frank Castle and investigates his connection to the homicidal vigilante prowling the city.

episodes.title: Kinbaku
episodes.summary: While Matt deals with Elektra in the present, he remembers what happened between them ten years ago. Meanwhile, Blake pressures Foggy for information on the Grote case, and Karen digs into Frank's background when she suspects coverup.

episodes.title: Regrets Only
episodes.summary: Elektra convinces Matt to let her help eliminate the Yakuza from New York City. Meanwhile, Nelson & Murdoch agree to enter a plea for Frank, and Karen learns more about their new client.

episodes.title: Semper Fidelis
episodes.summary: Foggy tries to defend Frank in court, despite Matt's continuing absence as Daredevil teams up with Elektra to find out what the Japanese are up to.

episodes.title: Guilty as Sin
episodes.summary: Foggy tries to mount Frank's legal defense despite Matt's ongoing absence. Meanwhile, Matt is reunited with an old friend and discovers his connection to Elektra... and the secret of the Hand.

episodes.title: Seven Minutes in Heaven
episodes.summary: Wilson arranges for Frank to meet him in prison. Meanwhile, Foggy tries to keep the law firm afloat but discovers that Matt isn't interested.

episodes.title: The Man in the Box
episodes.summary: People connected to the Central Park massacre are brutally gunned down, but Karen suspects that someone is setting Punisher up for a fall. Meanwhile, Matt convinces Claire to look after the Hand prisoners, but it turns out that they may not be as helpless as they appear.

Karen escapes her protective custody and meets with Frank, who is on the trail of Blacksmith. Meanwhile, Daredevil's own search for the elusive drug lord takes him to Madame Gao, who warns that his quest won't end well.

episodes.title: The Dark at the End of the Tunnel
episodes.summary: After the Hand abduct Stick, Daredevil traces them to their lair beneath the city. Meanwhile, Karen continues her investigation into Frank's background after his death.

episodes.title: A Cold Day in Hell's Kitchen
episodes.summary: Daredevil battles the Hand--with Elektra at his side--and discovers that the price of victory may prove too high to accept.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the battle with the Hand, Matt loses part of his hearing and heals with the aid of the nuns at the orphanage where he grew up. Meanwhile, Foggy and Karen try to move on with their lives, and an FBI agent reaches out to Fisk with surprising results.

episodes.title: Please
episodes.summary: While Matt suffers a crisis of faith, Fisk finds himself the target of inmates trying to kill him because he's become a snitch.

episodes.title: No Good Deed
episodes.summary: The FBI move Fisk to a $20 million hotel penthouse to protect him, but the public soon learns of it. Matt considers what to do next, while Karen learns of a connection between Fisk and the Kazimis.

episodes.title: Blindsided
episodes.summary: Matt goes prison using Foggy's stolen bar card to get information on Fisk from the Albanians, while Foggy and Marci settle on the best way for Foggy to protect himself from Fisk.

episodes.title: The Perfect Game
episodes.summary: Fisk analyzes Dex's past while looking for a scapegoat to take the public's eye off of him. Meanwhile, Ray questions Foggy and Karen about their involvement with CGI and Wesley's disappearance.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.summary: Fisk makes Dex an offer, while Foggy negotiates a deal with the FBI for Matt to turn himself in.... if they'll listen to an exonerating witness first.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.summary: Ray begins to suspect that Fisk has been playing him as well as the entire FBI. Meanwhile, Matt, Karen, and Foggy each deal with the aftermath of the Bulletin attack in their own way.

episodes.title: Upstairs/Downstairs
episodes.summary: Dex reaches out to Julie but Fisk has other plans. Daredevil teams up with Ray to get the good on Dex, and Karen confront Fisk in his penthouse.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.summary: While Matt takes in the news of who his mother is, Karen prepares to run, Foggy gets some bad news from his brother, and Fisk tightens his fist on the NYC underworld.

episodes.title: Karen
episodes.summary: In the past, the reason behind Karen leaving home is revealed. In the present, Dex tracks Karen to the church and Daredevil tries to stop him.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: After the church slaughter, Ray has a decision to make and puts his family at risk. After Maggie gives him sanctuary, Matt meets with Karen and Foggy to decide on a plan of action against Fisk.

episodes.title: One Last Shot
episodes.summary: Vanessa returns to NYC but Fisk realizes that something is bothering her. Meanwhile, Murdock & Nelson represent a new client, but Fisk has anticipated their strategem.

episodes.title: A New Napkin
episodes.summary: As Fisk and Vanessa prepare for their wedding day, Daredevil makes a call to Dex that pushes him over the line.
